title: Check that the new 401(k) percent reached your paycheck
rationale: The contribution was raised to 28% on Nov 14, before the Nov 19 payroll cutoff. The Nov 30 paystub is the first to show whether payroll applied it; if it didn't, the two December paychecks need more to reach the year's limit.

steps.text: Open the Nov 30 paystub and check that the 401(k) pre-tax deduction is 28% of base pay
If it isn't, set pre-tax to the whole percent that reaches the limit over the two December paychecks
